title: A Confession for the Alibi
author: Casper Montrose
blurb: Coral Amberdale, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
